in_sanskrit.name: कृतिका
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: She who creates, forms, or makes. This is a name for the goddess of arts and crafts, or the moon, or a creative person.

in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who is made or created. In Hindu mythology, Krithika is the name of the constellation known as the Pleiades.

in_marathi.name: Kruthika
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of dance
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kruthika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Kruthika is the name of a group of celestial musicians and dancers. They are often depicted accompanying Lord Shiva in his divine dance, Tandava.
